# NOTE (corrected 2026-09-07 by the wave lead, after Wave 7 lane A).
# The "callers:" line below is generated by tools/runtime_census.py, which reports the file
# that performs the ResolveExport/ResolveAddr — NOT the files that ultimately CALL the
# resulting function pointer. For anything resolved in engine/funcs/engine_funcs.cpp or
# standalone/address_registry.cpp, that line therefore UNDERSTATES the live consumers, and
# the difference is load-bearing: lane A's hold-back decisions turned on exactly it.
#
# Verified for the four lane-A rows this bit:
#   ??0Element (ctor)      LIVE: code/Game/Component/captureboxelement.cpp:23,
#                                code/Game/Component/frustumoutlineelement.cpp
#   ?Draw@Element          LIVE: code/Game/Component/frustumoutlineelement.cpp:206
#   ?ComputeLayout@Element LIVE: code/Game/Component/frustumoutlineelement.cpp:74
#   ??1Element (dtor)      NO CALLER ANYWHERE -- only the extern decl at engine_funcs.h:4064.
#                          This is half of why lane A held the dtor back: a registered port on
#                          a dead path reports calls=0 divergences=0 forever and reads as a pass
#                          (reference_uncalled_port_is_not_verified.md).
#
# Before treating any row here as "only used by engine_funcs", grep the fn_* name across
# code/, standalone/ and dx11/ for the real consumers.
